Introducing Saved Views, available today for every customer on a paid plan. Saved Views let you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, so you never have to rebuild your perfect setup from scratch. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a sprint, or checking in on a client's project, you can save that configuration once and return to it with a single click.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize views by project, priority, or workflow stage. And because great work is rarely solo, any view can be shared with your team, so everyone sees the same filtered, sorted list without repeating setup steps.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost — there's nothing new to buy and nothing to configure beyond your own preferences.

We think this small addition will save real time across your daily workflow. Give it a try today.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
